periods.time: vol-10 ch-005, night after the scheduled final day

name.zh: 海江田批准延期的一辉史黛菈决赛
name.en: Kaieda approves the delayed Ikki-Stella final

periods.summary: Ikki wakes in a hospital room at 10:30 p.m. on the day after the semifinals and realizes he has slept through the scheduled final. He reads Stella's message saying she is waiting in the arena and runs there in despair. Stella tells him she waited all day because she wanted his true feeling, not an apology; when Ikki curses his own failure, the arena lights come on and the crowd reveals that everyone has waited for him too. Chairman Yuzo Kaieda says the final is not over because the spectators will not accept a Seven Stars Festival without Ikki versus Stella. After Ikki and Stella confirm their will by crossing Intetsu and Laevateinn, Kaieda uses committee authority to approve the final for the next night at 7 p.m.
periods.cause: Kiriko saves Ikki, but his recovery sleep makes him miss the original final time; Stella and the audience refuse to let the promised match end by absence.
periods.outcome: The Ikki-Stella final is officially rescheduled, and both finalists are told to prepare in peak condition.
periods.significance: Preserves the central promise of the series and ends vol-10 by setting the true Seven Stars final as the next climax.
